pages.text: $(l)Veil Step$() tears a door into the Hollow: islands of pale stone adrift in a lightless sky, where ash falls forever and the Shades walk.$(br2)Nothing there was made for you. Some of it was made $(l)before$() you.
pages.title: Beyond the Veil

pages.text: $(li)Bring light. The Hollow has none of its own.$(li)Bring a way home. Veil Step works in both directions; so does $(l)Recall$().$(li)Mind the edges. The void below does not give back what it takes.
